segments.sn4.12:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.sn4.12:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ deseti.
segments.sn4.12:2.2: “ayaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ deseti.
segments.sn4.12:2.3: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkameyyaṃ vicakkhukammāyā”ti.
segments.sn4.12:2.4: Atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn4.12:3.3: Paṭimallo hi te atthi, vijitāvī nu maññasī”ti.
segments.sn4.12:5.1: Atha kho māro pāpimā “jānāti maṃ bhagavā, jānāti maṃ sugato”ti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.

lines: Buddhānaṃ panesa paññācakkhuṃ vināsetuṃ na sakkoti, parisāya bheravārammaṇaṃ sāvento vā dassento vā sakkoti.
Vijitāvī nu maññasīti kiṃ nu tvaṃ “vijitavijayo ahan”ti maññasi?
Mā evaṃ maññi, natthi te jayo.
Yathā sā bhagavato desiyamānaṃ dhammaṃ attano paññācakkhunā na passituṃ sakkoti, evaṃ kātuṃ kāmatāya.
